name: Zip
summary: Zip is an intake-to-procure platform that routes employee requests through approval flows, generates purchase orders and runs a supplier onboarding portal. It publishes no prices and offers live demos. Its homepage lists SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 1 Type 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR.

facts.text: Zip says intake converts plain-language employee requests into completed forms and routes them for approval automatically.
The procure-to-pay page says teams can track all purchase orders and projected spend and manage change orders.
Zip says supplier records are stored centrally, duplicates are flagged, and onboarding runs through a guided supplier portal.
The homepage lists SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 1 Type 2, ISO 27001, GDPR and EU-US Data Privacy Framework certifications.

plans.name: Zip
plans.notes: No plans or prices are published. The site offers live demos and ROI calculators

hiddenCosts: The site does not say how Zip prices its products, so the unit and any add-on fees are unknown until a quote.
